tema: Review 3 — Modals & Prepositions: Can, Must, Should, Have To, Would Like, In/On/At

vocabulario.palabra: between the café and the bank
vocabulario.traduccion: entre el café y el banco

cast_dialogue.linea: Third checkpoint, heroes! Powers, duties, advice, wishes — and the words that place everything in space and time.
I can ski, but I must wear a helmet. The class is on Monday at nine.
I have to study tonight, but I'd like a coffee first!
You should rest, Kenji. The exam is in April, not tomorrow!
The pharmacy is next to the bank, between the café and the post office. You can't miss it!

banco_oraciones.oracion: Ben can ski, but he must wear a helmet.
The pharmacy is next to the bank.
She doesn't have to work on Saturdays.
You shouldn't drink so much coffee.
Is the exam on Monday or in April?
Can he ski? Yes, he can.
Would you like a tea? No, thank you.
Must I wear a helmet? Yes, you must.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: You must to wear a helmet.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Checkpoint of lessons 14-18 and 21-22: can (ability), must/mustn't (rules), should (advice), have to (duties), would like (polite wishes), and prepositions of place and time (in/on/at, next to, between, opposite).

filas: in April, on Monday, at nine

ejercicios.pregunta: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It's forbidden.
I've got a headache. You ___ rest.

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'Don't have to' means something is not necessary.

ejercicios.texto: The pharmacy is ___ to the bank. (al lado)

ejercicios.oracion_base: He has to wear a uniform.
ejercicios.respuesta: Does he have to wear a uniform?
I would like a coffee, please.

ejercicios.pregunta: Say one ability, one rule and one wish you have. (3 sentences with can, must, would like.)
ejercicios.respuesta: I can swim. I must do my homework. I would like a bike.

guion: Aurora: Checkpoint three! Ben, what can you do?
Ben: I can ski and play the guitar.
Aurora: Kenji, what do you have to do tonight?
Kenji: I have to study, but I'd like a coffee first.
Aurora: Sofía, what should Kenji do?
Sofía: He should rest! The exam is in April, on Monday, at nine.
Aurora: And where is the coffee? In the café, next to the bank!

reading.texto: It's Monday morning and the heroes are busy. Ben can ski, but today he has to work. Kenji has to study for his exam in April, but he'd like a coffee first. Sofía says he should rest more. The café is next to the bank, opposite the park, and it opens at nine. On Saturdays they all meet there. Friends, coffee and English — a perfect plan!

preguntas.afirmacion: The café is behind the bank.
They meet at the café on Saturdays.

ejercicios.texto: You ___ smoke here. It's forbidden. (mustn't/don't have to)
I ___ study tonight. It's my duty. (have to/would like)

partes.parte: B — Preposiciones de tiempo y lugar

ejercicios.texto: ___ Monday ___ nine (el lunes a las nueve)
___ April / ___ night (en abril / por la noche)
The pharmacy is ___ to the bank, ___ the café and the post office. (al lado / entre)
Corrige: 'You must to wear a helmet.'
Corrige: 'I would like drink a coffee.'
Escribe 4 oraciones: una habilidad (can), una regla (must), un consejo (should) y un deseo (would like).

answer_key: 9. I would like a coffee. / I would like to drink a coffee.
10. Respuesta libre (ej. 'I can swim. I must do my homework. You should rest. I would like a bike.')
